escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Asia this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, I GOT OWNER INFINITE LUCK IN STEAL AN EGG ROBLOX !!, by Shivang Mini, with over 14 thousand comments.
In second place, なにわ男子 - 僕がカワイくて君がカワイくて [Official Music Video], by なにわ男子, with over 20 thousand comments.
And number one: MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY | GTA 6 GAMEPLAY, by Techno Gamerz, with over 54 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
